To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the self reflective cycles that characterize action learning can be applied to the praxis of ecological leadership, 2) action learning praxis can be applied to both formal and non formal settings, 3) the application of action learning praxis in formal settings can be used to teach students the pedagogy of participatory design, and 4) the application of participatory design in formal settings can lead to the development of a more just and sustainable society.
the application of the reflective cycles of action research can help educators and learners alike to develop their ecological leadership skills.

(a) action learning can be a powerful tool for self-reflection and transformation, (b) educators can benefit from engaging in a process of action learning with other educators, and (c) the process of action learning can be used as an educational tool for preparing students for experientially based learning activities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and implementation of pedagogical practices that support students in becoming ecological leaders.
how educators can make pedagogy explicit to their students, and how students can be empowered through this knowledge.
how to make the pedagogy of action oriented curricula more explicit.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
praxis is the process of making pedagogy explicit.

praxis is a process that requires educators to be intentional in their approach to preparing learners for action oriented curricular activities, and that this process of intentional preparation is a necessary component of the praxis cycle.
praxis is not only a process of linking theory and action, it is also a process of making pedagogy explicit.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are calling for educators to make pedagogy explicit and to do so in the context of the self reflective cycles and critical action research of action learning.

the self reflective cycles and action learning praxis that we have each employed has been an effective means for us to engage in critical and transformative thinking about our own practice and to make our pedagogy more explicit.
we have learned that action learning can be an effective tool for personal growth and development, and that it can be a powerful catalyst for social change.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the self reflective cycles that we have used in our own praxis can be used by educators in any field of study to help them become better teachers, to help their students become better learners and to help both educators and students become better people in their communities.
we must not only teach the content of environmental adult education, but also its pedagogy.
the more we make pedagogy explicit, the more we can prepare students to learn from their experience.
